query:
SELECT
            count(*) AS "commands!"
        FROM
            email_mailbox_commands c
            JOIN email_mailbox_command_targets t ON t.command_id = c.id
            JOIN email_messages m ON m.id = t.message_id
        WHERE
            c.link_id = $1
            AND m.provider_id = $2
            AND c.intent = '{"kind":"junk","value":true}'::jsonb
